parsed.rationale: The two methods `_DequeStorage._growIfNeeded` (line 334) and `_DequeStorage._shrinkIfNeeded` (line 354) in `Shared/Core/Sources/Core/Deque.swift` are structurally similar (Jaccard 0.714) but encode intentionally opposite and complementary capacity-management operations on a deque's backing storage. Growth and shrink logic necessarily mirror each other in shape — threshold checks, reallocation calls, copy steps — yet they diverge in the direction of the capacity change and the conditions that trigger it. Merging or abstracting them into a single generic helper would obscure the semantic distinction between expansion and contraction, harming readability and making future tuning of each policy independently more error-prone. No restraint markers are present, but the coincidence of structure is a direct consequence of the dual nature of the operation, not an accidental duplication.
